snippet.title: Remnants of the Rift - 1.0 - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656050/Remnants_of_the_Rift/
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/remnants-of-the-rift-switch/
https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Remnants-of-the-Rift-2835910.html?s=countries

What if closure was at the end of another dimension? Prepare to dive into retro-futuristic action roguelite Remnants of the Rift to search for the answer! 

Dive into a world between worlds as the game is available now for Steam and Nintendo Switch 1.

Discord: https://discord.gg/pEaZ3RUt84 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BromioDev 
Website: http://remnantsoftherift.com/
